viewport: Desktop with motion on: 1280x720, 1440x900, 1920x1080 and 2560x1080. At 390 and below, and with reduced motion, the crossed-arms still stays.
problem: The hub is meant to show Kain with crossed arms (template comment: 'clip con alfa, brazos cruzados'). Instead the clip plays once and freezes on a wave. The wave is the same pose as the hero plate (kain-hero) and the Dawn close, so there are three waves on one page. The hero and the hub are consecutive Kain scenes, which breaks R13 (no repeated pose in two scenes in a row).
evidence: ProductTemplate.astro line 137 sets CLIP_HUB = { video: '/video/kain-brazos.webm', still: kain-brazos-cruzados.webp, loop: false }, and the script leaves a 'once' clip on its last frame. A CDP probe at 1280x720 read .prd-kain--hub 'is-playing' with video ended:true, currentTime 5.04, still opacity 0. Timed crops (hubt-sheet.jpg) show crossed arms turning into the raised-hand wave. public/img/kain/kain-brazos-last.webp, the clip's last frame, is the wave.
fix: For a 'once' clip, keep Kain on a crossed-arms frame at rest. Options: on 'ended', set currentTime back to 0 and remove is-playing so the crossed-arms still shows again; or loop only a crossed-arms segment; or skip the clip in the hub and keep the still. Either way, the hub must not end on the hero's wave.

viewport: 1280x720, 1440x900, 1920x1080 with real scroll, while the que-es top sits about 0.6 to 0.45 viewport below the fold
problem: Text runs over the subject. The hero is subject-center, so the shared take keeps Kain sharp in the middle of the screen while the definition section scrolls in. The definition paragraph (left column) and the facets column (right) slide across Kain's legs and hips before the blur takes over. In that stretch, muted copy sits on Kain's light-grey legs. The approved service page shows no such overlap because its subject is on the right and the text crosses the empty phone.
evidence: Captures tq-0.jpg and tq-1.jpg (1440), tq-cmp.jpg (1920 and 1280): 'donde las empresas', 'Kain, el personaje, es la', 'agenda, confirma, da' and 'en WhatsApp, Instagram,' are drawn over Kain's thighs and shins. ProductTemplate.css line 149: .prd-def__grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr)}, so the left column runs past the centre of the frame, where Kain stands. check-contraste passes only because it measures with reduced motion, where the take is static.
fix: For a subject-center take, keep both columns clear of the centre band. For example, place the definition in columns 1–5 and the facets in columns 9–12, or stack the facets under the definition on the left. Another option is to blur and dim the take fully (or slide Kain sideways) before the que-es text reaches the middle of the viewport.

viewport: All (the problem is in the HTML)
problem: The body never links to /servicios/agentes-ia-whatsapp/. That page is built (HTTP 200), it is the first entry in this page's sitemap internalLinks, and it is the main commercial page for Kain. Only the mega menu and footer reach it. The product page should feed it in-body link equity, and a reader who wants the service has no path from the content.
evidence: In <main> of curl http://127.0.0.1:4321/kain/, href="/servicios/agentes-ia-whatsapp/" appears 0 times. Counts for the other internalLinks: /industrias/ 1, /casos/clinica-dental-monterrey/ 3, /kommo/ 1, /gohighlevel/ 1, https://app.kain.mx/ 3, /discovery/ 2. sitemap.json kain.internalLinks[0] = "/servicios/agentes-ia-whatsapp/".
fix: Add a contextual link in the copy. Options: an href on a #hago item (for example 'Respondo en segundos' or the WhatsApp row) or in the #donde channel 'WhatsApp Business' → /servicios/agentes-ia-whatsapp/; or a 'Cómo implementamos un agente para WhatsApp →' link in #que-es or #plataforma, rendered through linkTarget().

problem: On mobile the simulated app window cuts every message to one line with an ellipsis, which removes the meaning. Examples: 'Listo: tu limpieza quedó el viernes a las 17:…', 'Esa pregunta la ve la doctora. Te paso con…', 'Te envío la confirmación de tu visita por c…'. evidence: DOM probe: .prd-appui__msg has scrollWidth > clientWidth on 4 of 5 rows at 390, and on 5 of 5 at 360 and 320. .pwin__title overflows at 360 and 320 (sw146 > cw99 at 320). Visible in m-sheet-3.jpg frame 3 and sheet-320.jpg. Cause: ProductTemplate.css line 349, .prd-appui__msg{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.
fix: Under 768px, let .prd-appui__msg wrap to 2 lines (white-space:normal plus -webkit-line-clamp:2). On narrow screens, pass a shorter window title (for example 'Hoy') or let the title wrap.

Rewrite the page-owned lines: facet 02 could cover what the platform gives the client; plataforma.lede could open on what happens there, not repeat the definition; hago.limite could point to #si-no instead of restating it.

problem: The '1 vista · 7 fuentes' row (ecom-tablero) in the results section shows 'Ver caso →', links to /casos/ecommerce-cdmx-costo-por-lead/ and uses that case's still image. Capture: scratchpad/audit-ind/shots/retail-ecommerce-d/09.jpg and sheet-1.jpg.

problem: Honesty and attribution: the cases section's H2 is 'Kommo con IA, operando hoy mismo.' problem: In the 'precio' and 'crm' topics, the isotipo aura sits right behind the text column, so some text drops below AA contrast (ESPEC §2.1.1 makes AA mandatory). The worst case is the 12 px cyan mono line 'La implementación toma de 7 a 30 días, según el alcance.' Its words 'DÍAS, SEGÚN' are cyan on a light-cyan glow and are visibly hard to read.
evidence: Measured on the brightest pixel under each text line, the same method as scripts/check-contraste.mjs, with reduced motion. .faq-price__line (12 px, #00E5FF; the cyan marker square was excluded): 1.67:1 at 1280x720, 1.78:1 at 1440x900, 1.96:1 at 1920x1080, 8.98:1 at 390x844. Lede '#crm .faq-sec__lede' (20.7 px, weight 400): 2.30:1. Lede '#precio .faq-sec__lede': 2.58:1. Both ledes need 4.5:1. Captures: scratchpad/aud-fcl/price-zoom.jpg, crm-lede.jpg, precio-lede.jpg. Cause: the LIGHT map in src/components/templates/FaqTemplate.astro:118 and :120 places the crm isotipo at x 14% / y 30% and the precio isotipo at x 20% / y 44% with opacity 0.7–0.8. Both positions are under the 5-column head. check-contraste.mjs only scans section.is, so it does not catch this.

Also set .faq-price__line to var(--soft) or white, keeping the cyan only on the marker square. Re-measure at 1280, 1440 and 1920.

problem: The published notice names a responsible party that is not confirmed and misses data channels the v2 site uses. It names 'Ingeniak Technology, LLC, 131 Continental Drive, Newark, DE' and a personal representative (Ricardo Alejandro Gutiérrez Landeros). ESPEC §12.5-3 and §8.5 require written confirmation of the legal name, and the footer and JSON-LD deliberately leave legalName out. The text has no clause on analytics or cookies, which R10 requires, and it does not cover the WhatsApp conversation with Kain or the 7-question Discovery form on agenda.ingeniak.tech. The v1 disclaimer ("modelo estándar… no sustituye la revisión de un abogado") was removed from public view, but the lawyer's review has not happened. ESPEC §12.3 lists this as a launch gate.
evidence: src/content/paginas/aviso.json pendientes 2–5 list each item as open. The rendered clauses 01 and 09 show the LLC and the personal name. The legal text matches materiales/v1/aviso-privacidad/index.html word for word, apart from the removed note. No clause mentions Vercel Analytics, cookies, WhatsApp/Kain or agenda.ingeniak.tech.
fix: The client needs to confirm the responsible entity and its address in writing. A data-protection lawyer then reviews and approves the R10 cookies/analytics clause and the coverage of WhatsApp-agent and Discovery-form data. Update aviso.json, including 'updated', after approval. Until then, keep the page in 'borrador' and out of launch.

problem: On desktop the index's <summary> looks like a static 'ÍNDICE' label but is still a focusable disclosure control. A keyboard user who tabs to it and presses Enter collapses the whole index. What is left is a bare 'ÍNDICE' label with no chevron, and because the summary has pointer-events:none, a mouse user cannot reopen it. Screen readers announce it as an expand/collapse button.

fix: At ≥1024 px, set tabindex="-1" on the summary and preventDefault on its click/toggle. Simpler: in the existing script, listen for 'toggle' and force details.open = true while !narrow.matches. Alternatively, render the desktop label outside <details>.

For example: the oficina lede's 'zona metropolitana de Guadalajara' to /agentes-ia-guadalajara/; 'mismo equipo' in the hero or the rutas lede to /nosotros/; a micro line under the routes table such as 'Cómo tratamos tus datos: Aviso de privacidad' to /aviso-privacidad/.

problem: Between the hero and the closing scene, the page repeats one skeleton six times: about 7,600 px at 1440 and about 12,500 px at 390. Fold the six 'Para profundizar' blocks into one closing index before the Dawn, or show them only on hover/focus. Optionally merge 'automatizacion' into a shorter band, since it has only 2 answers.
